text:
Maya Nguyen: Planning note  webinar launch social push next week. Need X thread, LinkedIn longform, hero assets, and routing for demo signups. Can we lock timings and owners?
Alex Park: I can take the X thread + 1-paragraph LI post. Need final slide deck + hero image variants.
Liam O'Connor: I'll export the deck and a 30s highlight clip by EOD. Where should I drop the master?
Chris Patel: I'll create assets: 16:9 (LinkedIn), 1:1 (X card), and 9:16 (stories). Will upload to /marketing/assets/webinar_spring26/ by 4pm.
Rina Gomez: I'll write 3 copy variants (benchmark-led, feature-led, customer-quote) and short/long formats. Drop in #marketing-docs for review.
Maya Nguyen: Target publishing windows: X thread Tue 10:00 PT, LinkedIn Tue 11:00 PT. Employee advocacy send at 13:00 PT. Paid boosts Day0 morning + Day1 evening.
Jules Martin: Routing — we'll tag leads as hot if company_size>100 or job_title contains "Director"/"Head"/"VP". Hot => AE_inbound, others => nurture.
Priya Singh: Can we get a webhook to #inbound-leads with a 1hr rolling alert for hot leads? Want email, company, company_size, utm_campaign, variant.
Sam Reed: I'll wire the webhook and confirm payload. Proposed snippet:
```
{ "email": "{{email}}", "company": "{{company}}", "company_size": "{{company_size}}", "utm_campaign": "webinar_spring26", "variant": "A|B|C" }
```
Sam Reed: ETA for webhook + Zapier route: tonight. Will include Slack notification to #inbound-leads and CRM tag mapping.
LegalBot: Draft copy with the phrase "~2x latency improvement" is pre-cleared if you use compliant language: "observed ~2x latency improvement in our internal benchmark." Any cost or savings claims need supporting data uploaded to /legal/claims/ first.
Alex Park: Thanks LegalBot. We'll use legal-approved phrasing for benchmark-led variant.
Rina Gomez: For CTAs, I want to A/B test "Reserve your seat" vs "Watch on-demand" (variant tracked via UTM). Will label links accordingly.
Chris Patel: Also confirm: X card should be 1200x1200 and LI hero 1200x628? I can export both and a vertical 1080x1920 for stories.
Liam O'Connor: Yep, those sizes work. Uploading masters to shared folder. Will attach .vtt captions for the clip.
SocialBot: Auto-schedule available for X thread + reply clip and LinkedIn post. Would you like reply cadence?
Maya Nguyen: Plan: X thread root at 10:00, reply 1 (signup CTA) at +30m, reply 2 (30s clip) at +90m, poll at +3h. LinkedIn main post at 11:00 and employee-share at 13:00 with suggested templates.
Alex Park: I'll post draft thread in #marketing-docs by 3pm for quick QA. Will include CTA link with UTM: utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_spring26_variantA (or B/C).
Jules Martin: SDRs confirm SLA: reach out to hot leads within 60 minutes. We'll create an AE assignment rule in the CRM.
Priya Singh: Also want a field 'interest_area' (choices: inferencing, cost_optimization, security) in the signup so we can route by product-fit. Sam, can you add that?
Sam Reed: Will add interest_area. Confirming payload will include it.
Rina Gomez: Suggesting engagement follow-ups in X thread: short poll to surface feature interest and a scheduled reply with a 15s teaser clip to boost re-shares.
Chris Patel: I'll prepare both 30s highlight and a 15s teaser. Teaser will be optimized for mobile with caption burned in.
Maya Nguyen: Micro-influencer seeding: @Rina and @Alex to prepare brief + suggested captions. Tony (if available) please compile a list of dev community accounts to seed. Note: any paid partnership must include disclosure ("#ad") per LegalBot.
LegalBot: Verified. Influencer disclosure required for paid placements. Provide contracts or permission docs before boosting.
SocialBot: Reminder set for 2026-05-04 09:00 PT to review final assets and queued posts.
Alex Park: One more ask: can we include a small testimonial quote image card? If people give consent, we'll use anonymized attendee feedback as fallback.
Liam O'Connor: If we get a quote, I'll design a card variant with the slide deck theme.
Maya Nguyen: Ok recap action owners: copy variants (Rina), X + LI copy (Alex), slides + clips (Liam), hero images + crops (Chris), webhook/CRMSync (Sam), SDR routing + SLA (Jules/Priya), legal clearance (LegalBot), scheduling (SocialBot/Alex). Drop final assets + copy by EOD tomorrow. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
